posts.name: MyClaw 3.0
posts.tagline: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
posts.description: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

posts.name: Airbot
posts.tagline: The AI chief of staff that texts you first
posts.description: Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

posts.name: Hiring Right Now
posts.tagline: Which startups would hire you?
posts.description: Paste your LinkedIn. Backdoor reads your work, searches growing startups and shows you the ones that fit, the founder to write to, and the email to send them. Free, no signup required, takes about two minutes.

posts.name: Snag by Parallel
posts.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
posts.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

posts.name: Canva MCP
posts.tagline: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
posts.description: Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

posts.name: Fompi
posts.tagline: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks
posts.description: Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

posts.name: Koed
posts.tagline: Supercharged Agents!
posts.description: Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

posts.name: Hai
posts.tagline: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call
posts.description: Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

posts.name: Omi X 2.0
posts.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
posts.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

posts.name: 3way.Social MCP
posts.tagline: Ask your AI to find link partners. You approve the deals.
posts.description: 3way.Social is a fair, credit-based marketplace for link insertions and guest posts, with no cold outreach. Each site chooses what it buys and sells, links are priced on industry-standard metrics (DR, traffic, spam score), and if a link disappears you get your credits back. AI discovery finds specific pages on your topic, not just domains. The MCP brings it into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT: ask for partner pages for your new post, then approve the deal.

posts.name: RelayRunner
posts.tagline: Swap between CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.
posts.description: RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.

posts.name: Falcon by Vybe
posts.tagline: Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work
posts.description: Get a free competitor analysis. Falcon, a Vybe agent, digs into your rivals and delivers a deep report: market landscape, feature parity, momentum, gaps left open, and competitors' go-to-market motions. The whole picture, not just a list of competitors. Want more than the report? Falcon runs on Vybe, so you can let an agent take the wheel, keep you updated on where the market is headed and turn the findings into work.

posts.name: MAGI-2
posts.tagline: Sand AI's 480B model for cinematic video generation
posts.description: MAGI-2 is Sand AI's flagship video generation model, creating up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Combine up to 20 image, video, and audio references to guide characters, scenes, styles, and sound. Direct shot changes and timeline events, or edit specific parts of existing videos. Built for creators who want more control over cinematic AI video production. Available through the Sand AI platform and API.

posts.name: eluna
posts.tagline: Period tracker for couples that explains WHY, not just WHEN
posts.description: most period trackers are a calendar with a countdown. eluna tells you WHY. a one minute check in and it writes a line from her own data: why day 24 feels heavy, why the bloating is back, what's coming next. ask eluna anything and it answers from her history, not a leaflet. then the part made for couples: partner mode gives him a heads up before the harder days, not after the fight. iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, 7 languages, free to start, built by a husband and wife

posts.name: VibeCode.surf
posts.tagline: AI code editor where agents build, run and test your app
posts.description: VibeCode.surf is an AI code editor for your desktop. Several agents plan, write, run and test your code on your own computer, with any model. Say what you want, and a lead agent splits the job across helpers that write the code, run it and test it in a real browser. It runs on your computer with any model, from Claude and GPT to a local one, and shows what every reply costs.

posts.name: Tray
posts.tagline: macOS file manager in a screen corner
posts.description: A file manager for macOS that lives in a screen corner. Drop files on the shelf, preview them, group them into a folder, drag them anywhere, or send them to the Bin — without opening Finder.

posts.name: Tendeck
posts.tagline: Run all your Claude Code and Codex agents on one Mac board
posts.description: Every coding agent becomes a card on one board. The card turns gold when an agent needs you, so nothing waits 40 minutes for a "yes". Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI, with worktrees, account switching and files on the card. $59 once.

posts.name: MemoryWorks
posts.tagline: Company memory for people and AI agents
posts.description: MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It captures decisions, context and know-how from your team's sources and makes it available to people and AI agents, always tied back to where it came from. Works with ChatGPT and Claude Code via an MCP server. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

posts.name: Blink
posts.tagline: Describe any trade and watch Blink build it
posts.description: "If they announce Jensen is back, long NVDA and short AMD." The news that moves a stock usually lands while you're asleep or in a meeting, and by the time you see it the move is over. Blink is a trading app where you describe any trade in plain English and it builds it, then watches around the clock. It can trigger on a post on X, a headline, an earnings result, a line said on a live earnings call or a shift in prediction market odds, and it places the trade the moment it happens.

posts.name: SteerLatch
posts.tagline: Connect MCP-compatible AIs to your computer
posts.description: SteerLatch connects MCP-compatible AIs to your authorized Mac/Windows PC: files, desktop, terminal, STOP and revocable access. NEW: control your paired PC from a phone/browser after local setup, while AI works. SteerLatch Context Hub shares project memory and messages across agents. Official apps are live on Apple App Store (iPhone companion) and Microsoft Store (Windows). Free 3-month trial: 3 PCs, 5,000 MCP calls/month, no card.

posts.name: Statefold
posts.tagline: Coding agents that keep working while you're away
posts.description: Statefold runs your coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi or Gemini CLI) on its own cloud computer, so it keeps working after you close your laptop. Give it a task and it writes the code, tests it and opens a pull request. If a check fails or a reviewer leaves a comment, the agent sees it and fixes it in the same conversation. Review the changes and merge from your computer or your phone. It works with the subscription or API key you already pay for.

posts.name: file.spot
posts.tagline: File transfer for creative professionals
posts.description: Share large files with clients on a delivery page in your own branding. Previews of every file, five layouts, and no account needed to download. Stored in the EU, no ads, and your work is never used for AI training.

posts.name: Continual-ARC
posts.tagline: OpenClaw doesn't learn from experience. Does your agent?
posts.description: Left to themselves, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Prime Agent failed to memorize puzzles they'd already seen, and didn't get better at solving new ones. In contrast, a small 9B model trained on the same stream got better at both. Run yours on the open benchmark.

posts.name: Hold'em
posts.tagline: Swipe real Black Friday cart deals across Shopify
posts.description: Black Friday online is mostly 40 open tabs and fake markdowns. Hold'em turns deal hunting into a card game across Shopify, checking live store carts for real automatic discounts and putting your keepers in one pack.

posts.name: Notely
posts.tagline: Notion-grade power & BYOK AI, stored locally in SQLite
posts.description: Ditch $120/yr note subscriptions. Notely is a 100% offline-first Windows 11 workspace backed by SQLite WAL + FTS5 search—no accounts, no telemetry, free forever. Open up to 24 Chrome-style tabs, write rich notes with resizable tables, sticky notes, built-in calculator & live inline stopwatch timers, compare word-level version history, lock sensitive notes with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, export losslessnotely/PDF via Print Studio, and opt in to BYOK Gemini or GroqCloud AI.

posts.name: PartGenie 2.0
posts.tagline: The AI workspace for hardware engineering
posts.description: PartGenie is the AI workspace for hardware engineering, connecting design, component intelligence, sourcing, and manufacturing in one place. Explore 60M+ electronic components, get datasheet-grounded answers, find verified alternatives & ECAD models, analyze BOMs, and move from engineering decisions to real-world sourcing and PCB/PCBA manufacturing. From design to build. Anywhere.

posts.name: PeerBand
posts.tagline: Reach every coding agent you run, from anywhere
posts.description: Connect the coding agents you run in Herdr across your laptop, desktop, and VMs. Check what they’re working on from ChatGPT or another MCP client. Get a Telegram message when an agent needs you, then reply to that exact agent from your phone. Install PeerBand on each machine and reach your agents without SSH.

posts.name: Qube
posts.tagline: An AI agent for anyone
posts.description: Qube is a personal AI assistant that works on your behalf, not just answers. It plans, uses tools, checks its own output, and comes back with the job done — real files, cited research, forms filled, apps updated. It's proactive: set a goal or a schedule and it runs the task to the end, asking only when a decision or risky action needs you. Your files stay on your machine. Free and open-source. Bring your own model — cloud or local — the assistant and its autonomy are the product.

posts.name: TruAstra
posts.tagline: Small practices based on your birthday + the current weather
posts.description: The sky sets the weather. You set the day. TruAstra computes your sidereal Vedic birth chart offline with the JPL DE440 engine on truastra.com and iPhone. When the sky scores your day low (like 34), three small daily practices (+3 each) visibly lift your day to 43. Every number opens inline to show its exact recorded planetary factor. Includes a live 9-planet sky dial with date jumps, 7-day curve, Dasha timing, Home and Lock Screen widgets, and an iPhone App Clip. 100% Free.

posts.name: Sen Việt (VieLotus-IM)
posts.tagline: Smart Bilingual input method for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
posts.description: Vietnamese input method. This repository contains the macOS Swift engine and InputMethodKit app, the C++20 Windows and Linux engines and adapters, and a freestanding WebAssembly SDK.

posts.name: GibHub
posts.tagline: Retrieve and compare Git versions
posts.description: GibHub — Git File History for Xcode Projects Git is an essential version control system for software development teams and solo developers alike. It allows you to track changes, maintain a history of your work, and return to previous versions when needed. Desktop applications such as GitHub Desktop and Sourcetree make Git easier to use.

posts.name: OpenEight
posts.tagline: The deterministic control layer for AI agents
posts.description: OpenEight helps teams trust AI agents with real work. Build with the SDK or connect an existing agent, then set policies for which tool calls can run, which need human approval, and which are blocked. Trace each decision to its reported outcome and export evidence anyone can independently verify.

posts.name: CodeRabbit Verify
posts.tagline: AI agent that tests your running app on every pull request
posts.description: CodeRabbit Verify is an agentic testing feature that runs your actual app in a sandbox and catches functional bugs before customers do. It builds test scenarios from a pull request, runs plain-English regression journeys on demand or on a schedule, and posts results with recordings, screenshots and logs. Findings can go to CodeRabbit Agent or another coding agent for a fix, or into Jira or Linear. Public beta: test runs are free.

posts.name: Oculon
posts.tagline: The agentic finance platform for the CFO's office
posts.description: Oculon is the agentic finance platform powered by agents that run complete workflows, with precision and control. From forecasts and variance analysis to reporting and data ops, connect tools like QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books, HubSpot, Salesforce, and agents build your first model in 10 minutes. Every agent works from a living context of your business, every number drills back to its source, and every action is brought back to you for approval. Compliant with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR.

posts.name: Band·je
posts.tagline: Dictate prompts and transcribe calls. On your Mac, no cloud
posts.description: Press ⌃⌥⌘D and talk: your prompt, mail or note is typed for you, in 25 languages. Use ⌃⌥⌘R to record any call on your Mac (Zoom, Teams, Meet, FaceTime) without a bot, and get the transcript with who said what. All on device. No account, no tokens. Pay once. - Mark important items with flags. - Plus on device models to summarise the transcript, following your own templates. - Export and as interactive audiopage, pdf, md. - iCloud optional. - Supports Mac, iPhone (Duo), iPad, Apple Watch + PWA/Web

makers.name: г๏єlคภ๔ ק. lคภ๔єﻮєภt

posts.name: Homa IR Test
posts.tagline: heath is main things
posts.description: The HOMA-IR Test (Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance) is used to estimate how effectively your body responds to insulin. It uses fasting blood glucose and fasting insulin levels to calculate a HOMA-IR score.

posts.name: Inclamo
posts.tagline: AI agent that answers store calls and chats, acts on orders
posts.description: Inclamo is one AI agent for your Shopify store's phone, web chat and email. It answers shoppers from your catalog, policies and order data, and takes the order actions you allow: refunds, free replacements, cancellations, address changes. Anything outside your rules goes to your team with the full conversation. A shopper can start in chat and call later without repeating the question. Free helpdesk; $0.49 per ticket, $0.29 per phone minute.

posts.name: AR Workflow
posts.tagline: AI Accounts Receivable for Contractors
posts.description: AR Workflow connects to QuickBooks Online and follows up on contractors' unpaid invoices by email, text and voicemail until they are paid.

posts.name: SaaSFriday.co
posts.tagline: 2026 Black Friday SaaS and AI Deals
posts.description: A directory of Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals on SaaS and AI tools for 2026.

posts.name: ETAOS
posts.tagline: Your entire company. One operating system.
posts.description: Companies don't have a software problem. They have a patchwork problem: 6 to 15 disconnected tools, data in silos, workflows stitched together by hand. ETAOS replaces the patchwork with one AI-native operating system configured around how your organization actually works - CRM, projects, finance, HR, analytics, learning, plus custom modules for anything else you run. One system, one memory. For the first time, you can talk to your business.

posts.name: DidYouSEO
posts.tagline: Free SEO audit
posts.description: SEO and AI search visibility platform: site audits, Search Console and GA4 reporting, AI visibility tracking, and a WordPress plugin.

posts.name: Travelandz Planner
posts.tagline: Where travel agencies sell, buy and run their trips
posts.description: Travelandz Planner is the B2B network where travel agencies, DMCs and tour operators work together. Agencies send requests to local partners, compare proposals and sell them under their own brand. DMCs and tour operators publish their catalogue and get requests from agencies across the network. Every trip runs in one booking file, from first enquiry to settlement, with AI and WhatsApp built in.

posts.name: Copilot Trips
posts.tagline: Real-Time Train & Flight Disruption Rescue, Worldwide
posts.description: Never get stranded or waste a trip again. Turn delayed trains, cancelled flights, and bad weather into a calm, timed rescue plan in seconds. Includes Google-verified open cafés and luggage drops nearby, plus one-tap UK Delay Repay, EU261, and US DOT compensation claims.

posts.name: FolioGen
posts.tagline: Turn your CV or business into a portfolio website
posts.description: Your CV lists where you worked. FolioGen turns it into a website that shows the work. Upload a CV (or answer five questions if you have none) and AI writes and builds your portfolio: headline, summary, projects with their own case study pages, and a contact form. Pick from seven templates, set your colours and fonts, and publish on your own link. See who visited with cookie-free insights, and tailor your intro to a specific job ad. Free to start, no account needed to preview.

posts.name: Xgraph
posts.tagline: Get customers from 𝕏 on autopilot.
posts.description: Xgraph is an audience intelligence and outbound engine for B2B founders, agencies, and sales teams prospecting on X. Map any account's followers on a 3D globe, enrich every lead, filter to your ICPs, and draft high-converting DMs. Get customers from X on autopilot.

posts.name: Data Career School
posts.tagline: Data, ML & AI Interview Prep | Projects | AI Mock Interviews
posts.description: Data Career School is an interview preparation platform for Data, ML and AI professionals. - Prepare with 300+ company-specific questions across SQL, DSA, AI Engineering, behavioral interviews, business case studies, and more. - Build hands-on projects across Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI using messy, real-world datasets. - Take AI-powered mock interviews to get instant feedback.

posts.name: LiveGrid Classic
posts.tagline: Watch Twitch, YouTube and Kick lives in one grid
posts.description: LiveGrid Classic puts several live streams on one screen: Twitch, YouTube, Kick and live TV links side by side, from 1 to 8 screens. Pick a category (GTA VI, CS, LoL, VALORANT, Dota 2...) and the grid fills with who is live right now, or paste any channel link. Swap, mute, reorder by dragging, open the Twitch chat, go cinema mode, share your grid. Free in the browser, up to 4 streams, no card. An optional Pro plan unlocks 8.

posts.name: KoiArt
posts.tagline: Christmas is here. On your Mac and PC
posts.description: Snow on every window, snowmen on your desktop, Santa riding by, a little train that delivers gifts to your friends, and a Yeti who wants your snowman. Buy once, use forever.

posts.name: GalleryQR
posts.tagline: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to set up your event photo gallery
posts.description: Ask ChatGPT, Claude or another assistant to set up your event's photo gallery. It connects over MCP. Guests scan a QR code and add photos and videos from their phone, and everything is saved to your own Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox. Try it, it's easy.

posts.name: DearBuddy
posts.tagline: A little buddy your whole family raises together — DearMate
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. A hand-drawn pet your whole family feeds, walks and talks to from their own phones. Everyone gets a private chat with Buddy. It never passes your words on.

posts.name: StapuBox
posts.tagline: India’s Hyperlocal Sports Platform
posts.description: We built StapuBox because running a tournament shouldn’t mean creating forms on google, chasing payment screenshots, making draws in Excel and chat groups on WhatsApp. We want to be a one stop solution for Sports. You can power end-to-end tournaments here, from registrations and payments to fixtures, scores, certificates and WhatsApp updates, for 70+ sports. Societies, companies, colleges and organisers use it, and players find games and squads on it beyond the tournament.

posts.name: gratis
posts.tagline: Use open source AI models locally for free in a few clicks.
posts.description: gratis runs open source AI models privately on your own machine, inside a browser tab or downloadable app, in just a few clicks. Free, with no usage limits. Pick a model from the catalogue or load any GGUF model from Hugging Face. gratis downloads it to your device and runs the model there. Browsers cap WebAssembly memory at 4GB, below what a useful model needs. We forked the inference runtime onto 64-bit addressing to reach 16GB, which is why a model of real size fits in a tab.

posts.name: GuestPass
posts.tagline: A guest link to your Claude Code session
posts.description: Run npx guestpass start in a Claude Code session and you get a link. Anyone with a browser can open it and type into that same live session, with all its context. No account, nothing to install. Runs on your machine over a Cloudflare quick tunnel. Free, MIT.

posts.name: Medjugorje Pilgrim
posts.tagline: Medjugorje radio, Gospel and maps, now on iPhone and Android
posts.description: Version 1.0.5 is out on iPhone and, for the first time, on Android. Listen to Radio Mir Međugorje with labelled AI interpretation, read the daily Gospel and homilies, check the parish programme and explore holy places with maps. New: medjugo.me links open in the app; layouts for iPad, tablets and foldables; an Advent journey with reminders; on-phone hymn recognition; clearer read-aloud; working Android widgets. Free, with optional tips and no locked features.

posts.name: iKnowMyDisplay
posts.tagline: Every display control macOS hides, in your menu bar
posts.description: A menu bar app for Mac displays: brightness and input for external monitors, Peak brightness on MacBook Pro, sharp sizes macOS hides, refresh rates, HDR and virtual screens. When a monitor is stuck at 30 Hz or blurry, it tells you why and what to change.

posts.name: Rethings
posts.tagline: Give your photos and video a look of their own
posts.description: Give your photos and video a look of their own. Build custom looks from 100+ stackable effects, mask people, shapes, 3D, and animate controls over time, all rendered locally on your machine with no subscription.

posts.name: SketchFlow
posts.tagline: A visual workspace that saves to a GitHub repo you own
posts.description: Most whiteboard tools keep your diagrams in their database. SketchFlow keeps them in yours: an Excalidraw canvas beside a BlockNote notes editor, where every save is one Git commit of plain files —excalidraw.json sketches and Markdown notes — to a repo in your GitHub account. Works with no account at sketchflow.space/try. Free and open source (MIT).

posts.name: 3Dangled
posts.tagline: 3D Device Mockup Generator for iPhone, Watch, iPad & MacBook
posts.description: Turn a screenshot into an angled 3D iPhone, iPad, MacBook or Apple Watch mockup. Free, no sign-up, no watermark: download a transparent PNG up to 4×.

posts.name: modelXare
posts.tagline: Help build local AI that can match frontier models
posts.description: Could thousands of specialized micro-models match frontier AI by working together? modelXare is a free, open-source project to find out. Contribute a model for a task you know well. A local router can bring specialists together for a request. You choose what runs, and in local mode your prompts, inference, and results stay on your device.

posts.name: Snaploom
posts.tagline: Virtual Photo Booth for Events, Online, No App
posts.description: Snaploom is a virtual photo booth that runs in the browser. Share one link or QR code and guests shoot branded polaroids on their own phones: no app, no hardware, no rental. Every photo carries your event name and logo and lands in your gallery, ready to download. Pick from 13 themes, style the card, and close the camera when the event ends. Free for 2 camera pages; passes for bigger events.

posts.name: Planndu
posts.tagline: Daily planner & calendar app built to reclaim your time
posts.description: Free task management app that brings your to-do list, notes, and calendar events together in one simple app. Stay focused across work and home with easy daily agenda and calendar app that replaces five tools.

posts.name: Timewize
posts.tagline: Run resources, projects & finances in one platform
posts.description: Timewize is a PSA platform for agencies, IT services, accounting and consulting firms. Plan resources, run projects, track time, bill clients and see project margin in one place. Built-in AI: an assistant that answers questions on your data, a time-draft assistant that pre-fills timesheets, a project agent that helps set up projects, and burn and predictive agents that flag budget overrun and margin risk early.

posts.name: Industrial Op Atlas
posts.tagline: Find industrial projects before they hit the bid boards
posts.description: Early industrial project leads from permits and filings in all 50 states, ranked daily for what you sell, mapped in 3D and researched by AI, with a built-in CRM. Free plan and 14-day trial.

posts.name: RepCabin
posts.tagline: An AI buyer that pushes back until your rep earns the deal
posts.description: RepCabin is AI sales roleplay for the moment a call turns: reps rehearse it out loud against an AI buyer who keeps pushing back. Try it free in 3 minutes, no signup. Public prices from $149 per rep a month billed annually.

posts.name: 3D Mockup
posts.tagline: Put a screenshot on a 3D device, download a PNG or an MP4
posts.description: Upload a screenshot or a video and put it on a laptop, a monitor, a tablet, a phone or in a browser window. Orbit the camera, set the light, download a PNG (up to 2x, transparent background too) or an MP4 from 2 to 30 seconds. Everything happens in your browser: no server, no sign-up.

posts.name: Timenox 360
posts.tagline: Field workforce management, from attendance to execution
posts.description: Timenox 360 connects field attendance, site visits, tasks and operational visibility in one workspace. Built for distributed teams in sales, service, logistics and multi-location operations, it gives employees a mobile app to manage their working day and managers a web portal to coordinate activity across locations. GPS location updates are tied to the active work session, from check-in to check-out. Start with a 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Adventure FM
posts.tagline: Discover music beyond your playlist.
posts.description: Tired of listening to the same songs? Adventure FM turns music discovery into a journey. Explore live radio stations from around the world, with recommendations based on your taste. Stay close to what you love or venture into the unexpected. Travel across countries on an interactive globe, save your favorite stations, and share discoveries as travel-inspired tickets. No sign-up or download needed. Just open your browser and explore for free. Go beyond the music you love.

posts.name: Optimator
posts.tagline: Audit your site, compare rivals, and boost AI visibility.
posts.description: Optimator is an AI-powered SEO and competitor analysis tool built for indie makers, startups, and SaaS founders. Audit your landing page, benchmark your product against competitors, identify gaps in your SEO strategy, and get actionable recommendations to improve your visibility. Optimize your website so AI search engines can discover, understand, and recommend your product to the right audience.

posts.name: Monfil
posts.tagline: Keep track of what matters to you
posts.description: Tired of browsing dozens of different websites each day to read about what happened in your field during the night? Monfil is a free, local, source-available desktop app that follows your whole field for you: blogs, release notes, papers, conference and job boards, from the sources you pick across 10+ different mediums. Start with a curated feedpack and keep track of what's going on in your field (or what you like - hobbyist feedpacks are also supported!) within a minute. No signup needed.

posts.name: Unmentioned
posts.tagline: The pages AI recommends from, and the work to get on them
posts.description: AI visibility dashboards tell you that ChatGPT doesn't mention you. Unmentioned tells you why, and hands you the fix. It asks ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity your buyers' real questions, scores you against the brands they recommend instead, and finds the pages those answers come from. Then it writes the plan to get on them: emails to list authors, forum replies, directory profiles and page outlines. A report you act on, not a dashboard you watch. Free preview, then one payment.

posts.name: OSINTtools.io
posts.tagline: Paste a lead, get the right OSINT tools. Free MCP server
posts.description: Start from the lead you hold (an email, username, phone, domain, IP, image or wallet) and see which OSINT tools take it, what they cost, and whether they touch the target. Run step-by-step kits, compare tools, or let Claude, Cursor or any MCP client pick tools through a free, no-key MCP server.

posts.name: VitaminFi: Learn Crypto
posts.tagline: VitaminFi app is the easy way to learn crypto by doing.
posts.description: Curious about crypto but not sure where to start? VitaminFi breaks crypto down into bite-size lessons you can complete in minutes. Follow a guided Learning Path, learn at your own pace, and earn rewards through daily Missions. Then try it hands-on in the Simulator, building your understanding step by step, without feeling overwhelmed.

posts.name: Hekara
posts.tagline: Home health agency operations you can self-host
posts.description: Hekara is an open-source platform that helps home healthcare agencies manage their day-to-day operations without depending on expensive, closed-source software.Manage caregiver schedules, fill open shifts in one click, monitor overtime, track credentials, organise patient care plans, handle billing and claims, and monitor operations from one dashboard.

posts.name: Flowvdo
posts.tagline: Turn a story idea into one finished Google Flow video
posts.description: Flowvdo is a Chrome extension that turns a story idea into a finished video made with Google Flow. It uses your own AI key to plan the story, characters and scenes. Then it generates every scene in your own Google Flow account, keeping the same characters from shot to shot. It joins the clips into one MP4 on your computer, checks the cost before each generation and keeps your keys in your browser.

posts.name: Etiklar
posts.tagline: Every supplement claim on your site checked against EU law
posts.description: Etiklar reads every product page of a supplement brand and marks each sentence EU rules do not allow, with the rule, a link to the official text and a sentence you can use instead. One price for the whole brand, and a new check every week.

posts.name: Spamle
posts.tagline: Five categories. Keep the answers coming.
posts.description: Spamle is a free browser trivia game for anyone who loves a quick recall challenge. Name answers across five categories: every correct hit resets the main clock, while harder-to-recall finds earn more points. Play the shared Daily edition, try timed Sprint or untimed Relaxed practice, revisit published games, and share a spoiler-free scorecard with friends. No account or app download needed.

posts.name: GovernPoint for SharePoint
posts.tagline: Find and fix SharePoint oversharing before Copilot does
posts.description: Grade every SharePoint site from A to F for Copilot oversharing, fix it with a preview, your approval and 30-day undo, and keep the evidence - all inside your tenant. 14-day free trial.

posts.name: SoreQen Platform
posts.tagline: One API key for 31 AI models. Change two lines.
posts.description: SoreQen Platform is an OpenAI-compatible API by ZorQelis AI. Keep your OpenAI SDK code, change the base URL and the key, and the same code reaches 31 models: our own SoreQen S1 series plus models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Qwen, Z.ai and more. Other labs' models are billed at the serving provider's list price, with no fee per call. Prepaid in dollars, no subscription, and every call itemised by model and key in the console.

posts.name: Kelimoji
posts.tagline: A Turkish-language word party game for one phone
posts.description: Kelimoji is a fast word-guessing party game in Turkish for friends and family, played on one phone. One player describes the word on the card without saying any of its five forbidden words while the team races the clock. 5,000+ hand-picked Turkish cards across 5 difficulty levels and 122 categories, 2 to 6 teams, and it works fully offline. Free, with no sign-up and no ads mid-round. All cards and the interface are in Turkish.

posts.name: Tutorials Kit
posts.tagline: Your agent keeps your tutorial videos in sync with your app
posts.description: Open-source CLI your coding agent uses to turn your app's workflows into narrated tutorial videos and written guides. One prompt in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex sets it up: it writes Playwright flows, records your app, narrates with ElevenLabs and renders with Remotion. Each time you ship a change, your agent runs check to find the tutorials that broke and rebuilds just those. MIT, runs locally, bring your own keys.

posts.name: SCRIBERFLO
posts.tagline: Transcribe Audio and Video to Text
posts.description: Scriberflo converts audio, video, and YouTube content into accurate transcripts with speaker labels, timestamps, AI tools, and flexible export options. Scriberflo also offers browsers based audio and video conversion and editing tools

posts.name: Niro
posts.tagline: Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, Qwen, Kimi & more on your iPhone
posts.description: Search across projects and AI agent conversations. Continue your Mac-based coding work from your iPhone. NIRO connects Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Kimi Code and MiMo in one local-first workspace. Use Universal Search to find indexed conversations, revisit project context with Project Memory, and pick up supported sessions through Niro Bridge. Features vary by agent.

posts.name: LiveGrid
posts.tagline: Screen share with friends: every screen at once, with sound
posts.description: LiveGrid is a group call app where everyone can share their screen at the same time, side by side, each screen with its own volume slider and its own sound. Open a room, send the link, and friends join from the browser, even on a phone. Nothing to install. Voice, chat and watching screens are free. Pro is US$ 4.99/mo with a 7-day free trial: unlimited sharing at source quality, up to 60 fps. Desktop app for Windows and Mac too.

posts.name: Wrapped for TikTok
posts.tagline: Your TikTok year in review, built from your own data
posts.description: Your TikTok Wrapped 2026: see your watch time, videos watched, binge sessions, top searches and your TikTok type – free and private, right in your browser.

posts.tagline: Every supplement claim on your site checked against EU law
posts.description: Etiklar reads every product page of a supplement brand and marks each sentence EU rules do not allow, with the rule, a link to the official text and a sentence you can use instead. One price for the whole brand, and a new check every week.

posts.name: Memento
posts.tagline: Turn your camera roll into a beautiful photo album
posts.description: Memento turns your camera roll into a beautiful, physical photo album delivered to your door. It picks the best shots from 1k+ photos and designs the whole thing. You can add memento right to a group chat, send photos, and say "make it". Supports iCloud and Google Photos. Totally free until you buy the album! It's the perfect gift for the holiday season. Text memento at +1 (929) 627-2531 to get started.

posts.name: GPTA - Get paid to train AI
posts.tagline: All AI training jobs in one place
posts.description: Connect our free MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT or any agent and say "Find me remote AI training jobs paying $150+/hr." It searches an up-to-date directory of open data labeling and AI training jobs from 20+ companies, including Mercor, Alignerr and OpenTrain.

posts.name: PHListing
posts.tagline: Write and submit your Product Hunt launch from one brief
posts.description: PHListing is a Chrome extension that turns a short brief into a complete Product Hunt listing: tagline, description, launch tags, categories and first comment. Every field is checked against Product Hunt's real limits and tag lists. You review and edit everything, then it submits a private draft or scheduled launch through Product Hunt's official API. Bring your own AI key or a local model. There's no account, no server and no subscription.

posts.name: Caminho Solo
posts.tagline: Learn AI, automation & build your own business
posts.description: Discover how to use AI, automation, and modern tools to build real projects and independent businesses. Caminho Solo offers free practical guides, tutorials, and structured learning paths in English and Portuguese.

posts.name: Beautifier for Gmail
posts.tagline: A calmer, clutter-free Gmail with a Liquid Glass look
posts.description: Beautifier for Gmail hides the clutter around your inbox (Gemini, Chat, Meet, upgrade buttons) and gives Gmail a calm Liquid Glass or flat look that follows your system's light or dark mode. Free, no tracking, never reads your email.

posts.name: SquareCount
posts.tagline: Counter widgets that live on your iPhone Home Screen
posts.description: SquareCount puts a counter on your iPhone Home Screen. Tap +10 after a set of pull-ups, or Espresso after a coffee, and it's logged. You never have to open the app. A tracker counts an amount or counts by kind, in small, medium or large widgets, light or dark. Free with one tracker. Pro is a one-time purchase that adds unlimited trackers, reminders, Lock Screen widgets and a backup to your own Google Sheet. No account, no ads, no tracking.

posts.name: CyberTwin
posts.tagline: See how an attacker reaches your data, from your own configs
posts.description: Upload your firewall, identity and cloud config files. CyberTwin shows the routes an attacker could take to the systems that matter and the one change that closes the most of them. Nothing is installed and nothing connects to your network. Try it on a FortiGate config in your browser.

posts.name: Voca Fun
posts.tagline: Practice vocabulary with quick games and live duels
posts.description: Pick a topic and practice English, Chinese, Korean, French, or Portuguese in short spelling, listening, and matching games. Play solo, challenge a friend to a live duel, and unlock new lands as you earn XP. Try it free in your browser without an account, or get it on iOS and Android. Optional Pro adds leveled study packs for exams like HSK, TOPIK, DELF, IELTS, and TOEIC.

posts.name: UsagePoint for SharePoint
posts.tagline: Know which Copilot seats are used before you renew
posts.description: UsagePoint shows which Microsoft 365 Copilot seats are in use, prices idle seats in pounds at the price you pay, and lets you nudge, reclaim or reassign them with approval, inside your own tenant. 14-day evaluation.

posts.name: Biomarker Tracker
posts.tagline: Track years of blood tests and see your biological age
posts.description: Biomarker Tracker is a free, open-source app that keeps years of lab results and body measurements in one chart. It works out your biological age (PhenoAge), heart age and fitness age, explains every marker in plain words with sources, and tells a real change from normal variation. It reads lab PDFs and imports Apple Health, Garmin, Oura and more. Everything stays on your computer: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Windows, macOS and Linux, or try it in your browser.

posts.name: Acctbot
posts.tagline: Accounting pipelines, live dashboards & agentic workflows
posts.description: Custom accounting pipelines, live dashboards, and agentic workflows for QuickBooks Online, Xero, Excel, US tax practices, and Shopify & Stripe payouts. Automates bank statement cleanup, vendor bill matching, Chart of Accounts mapping, and month-end close reporting.
